pqxgx8mc.variantName: Charles Bentley 4ft Pre-Lit 400 Twinkling LED Christmas Twig Tree in Pot - White
pqxgx8mc.sourceDescription: Our 4ft Pre-Lit White Twig Tree in Pot brings a minimal elegance to the festive season – its slender white branches catching the soft twinkle of 400 LED lights in a display that's contemporary, calm, and quietly stunning. Whether you're working with a smaller space or simply love a more refined, design-led Christmas look, this twig tree makes an unforgettable statement. Displayed in its own neat, weighted pot, it's ready to place and plug in – no stand required. The 400 pre-fitted LED lights are a continuous lit string, meaning a single loose bulb won't affect the rest of the display, and the gentle twinkling effect gives the whole tree a look that's especially magical after dark. At 4ft tall, it's ideal for hallways and other floor areas, adding festive warmth to any corner of the home. Ideal for: Floor areas, bedrooms, home offices, and contemporary or minimalist Christmas interiors. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from heat sources and open flame. CE certified. Features: • 400 twinkling LEDs create a soft • Magical glow – beautiful after dark and in low winter light • Slender white branches with a natural twig-inspired silhouette • Comes in its own weighted pot to avoid damage from strong winds • 400 continuous lit LED lights – one loose or missing bulb won't affect the rest of the display • Pre-lit for a fuss-free setup – no additional lights required • Plug-in power source – CE certified for UK and EU use • Twinkling light function • No timer included – plug controlled Includes: • 1x Pre-Lit White Twig Tree • 1x Pot base • Pre-fitted plug-in cable Materials: • Plastic (branches and pot) Weights: • Approx. 4kg Colours: • White Additional Info: • Styling: Position in a hallway or beside furniture for a cool sculptural take on Christmas decorating. Pairs well with silver. • Power: Plug-in. CE certified. Suitable for indoor use only. • Storage: Disassemble carefully and store in a cool dry place. Wrap branches loosely to avoid bending. • Care: For indoor use only. Keep away from heat sources and open flame. Some self-assembly required. Full instructions provided. Dimensions: H122, W60, D60cm Warning: indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and combustible materials. Place the weighted pot on a stable surface and keep the cable where it cannot be pulled or tripped over. Unplug before assembly, adjustment or cleaning. Do not use if the plug, cable, wiring or lights are damaged. Keep away from young children and pets. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
